articles.summary: ATLANTA, May 18, 2026 Artivion, Inc. (NYSE: AORT), a leading cardiac and vascular surgery company focused on aortic disease, today announced that it has completed the acquisition of its long-standing partner Endospan Ltd. ("Endospan"), a pioneer in the endovascular repair of aortic arch disease
